vol1:fig-cnn.name: convolution
vol1:fig-cnn.scope: Single-channel valid cross-correlation, stride 1, no padding or bias, output before activation. Uses the chapter vertical-line worked example.
vol1:fig-cnn.question: How does a moving input window produce one output while sharing the filter?

vol1:fig-prefill-decode.name: original-prefill
vol1:fig-prefill-decode.scope: One illustrative request using the original prompt and generated tokens. Cache entries belong to consumed tokens.
vol1:fig-prefill-decode.question: How do prompt-wide prefill and sequential decode build and reuse one cache?

vol1:fig-weight-activations-quantization.name: original-quantization
vol1:fig-weight-activations-quantization.scope: Illustrative two-term symmetric INT8 dot product; declared scales and zero-points; requantization before ReLU.
vol1:fig-weight-activations-quantization.question: How do two quantized operands become an accumulated and requantized output?

vol2:fig-ring-allreduce.name: original-ring-allreduce
vol2:fig-ring-allreduce.scope: Original four-GPU, four-chunk ring; rounds show logical dependencies, not measured durations.
vol2:fig-ring-allreduce.question: When do contributions add, and when do completed shards only copy?

vol3:fig-vol3-stream-ingestion.name: original-stream-ingestion
vol3:fig-vol3-stream-ingestion.scope: Illustrative byte stream in the original bounded head/tail geometry. Readiness order is not causal stdout/stderr order.
vol3:fig-vol3-stream-ingestion.question: How does a wrapping tail preserve recent bytes while omitting the middle?

vol4:fig-09-ray-update-epochs.name: original-ray-epochs
vol4:fig-09-ray-update-epochs.scope: Original sensor ray, cells, return, and occlusion geometry. Motion shows logical evidence updates.
vol4:fig-09-ray-update-epochs.question: Which cells acquire new evidence, and which remain old behind the return?

vol1:fig-serving-paged-kv-mapping.name: original-kv-paging
vol1:fig-serving-paged-kv-mapping.scope: Original eight-block pool with unchanged C/D ownership, no prefix sharing or compaction, and explicitly illustrative record capacity.
vol1:fig-serving-paged-kv-mapping.question: How do ordered cache pages resolve to scattered blocks without moving other requests?

vol2:fig-fsdp-parameter-lifetime.name: original-fsdp-lifetime
vol2:fig-fsdp-parameter-lifetime.scope: One rank and one sharding unit with resharding after forward; phase columns depict logical lifetimes rather than storage locations, bytes, or duration.
vol2:fig-fsdp-parameter-lifetime.question: Why do activations survive parameter release, and when can backward temporaries be freed?

vol3:fig-vol3-pagedattention-mapping.name: original-kv-copy-on-write
vol3:fig-vol3-pagedattention-mapping.scope: Original ten-position prefix, four-position blocks, and physical IDs; candidate B copies initialized tail entries before changing its mapping and appending.
vol3:fig-vol3-pagedattention-mapping.question: How can one candidate append without overwriting another candidate’s cached prefix?

vol4:fig-08-shared-capture-buffer.name: original-capture-buffer
vol4:fig-08-shared-capture-buffer.scope: Original copy/shared alternatives and ownership strip; mappings reference A, converted B retains frame identity, and release follows the final consumer.
vol4:fig-08-shared-capture-buffer.question: When can capture storage be reused while a converted representation of the same frame remains live?

vol1:fig-activation-checkpointing.name: original-activation-checkpointing
vol1:fig-activation-checkpointing.scope: Original five activation positions with saved checkpoints, deterministic forward replay, and last-use release; activation counts are not total memory.
vol1:fig-activation-checkpointing.question: How can backward reconstruct discarded activations without releasing values before their last use?

vol2:fig-storage-checkpoint-staging.name: original-checkpoint-staging
vol2:fig-storage-checkpoint-staging.scope: Original four-lane local-NVMe-first timeline; immutable captured generation, advancing live training, durable shard receipts, and manifest publication.
vol2:fig-storage-checkpoint-staging.question: Why can training resume before the new checkpoint is a committed restore point?

vol3:fig-vol3-context-zones.name: original-context-invalidation
vol3:fig-vol3-context-zones.scope: Original root/trunk/leaf requests with compatible resident cache; one identical trailing token illustrates prefix-dependent derived KV state.
vol3:fig-vol3-context-zones.question: Why must an unchanged trailing token be processed again after an earlier prefix change?

vol4:fig-11-intersample-overshoot.name: original-intersample-overshoot
vol4:fig-11-intersample-overshoot.scope: Original acceleration and velocity curves with normalized computed values, equal endpoint velocities, and instantaneous acceleration reversal; no finite jerk bound.
vol4:fig-11-intersample-overshoot.question: How can both sampled velocities pass while an interior peak exceeds the velocity ceiling?
